name: Pinball Arcade: Cactus Canyon
storyline: Cactus Canyon (1998): is a fun western themed table designed by Tom Kopera and Matt Coriale. It was the last "conventional" Bally pinball machine. Players take on the role of town Marshall as they try to clean up the town of Cactus Canyon before facing a showdown at the OK Corral! Along the way, they're challenged with gun fights, stampedes and saving Miss Polly. The playfield features a gold mine with a closeable door, a moving train and a bad guy with a hat that pops off his head. The west has never been this wild! Only 903 units of this table were produced.
